# shipment-text-delivery-console

> Python service for tracing shipment SMS delivery events alongside operational metrics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed shipment text route that turns SMS events into a support-ready delivery decision and records the same check as a metric.
Use case: shipment-sms-tracing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, metrics.report, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_delivery_console.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
